evidence.method: 147 long-form (>= 20 min) videos from 8 focus-music searches published in the last 90 days, ranked by views per channel subscriber (floored at 1,000); top 30 reviewed, at most 2 per channel.
evidence.not_used: Bright clickbait text over brains or faces (#3 MEMORIZE FASTER, #26 ADHD FOCUS) ranked, but they sell brainwave or medical claims this channel does not make.
evidence.v2_review: 2026-11-05: the owner's first art from guide 2026-11-04 compared with the top 30. The winners are nearly empty rooms where the window view fills most of the frame, bright golden-hour or clear blue-hour light, no person or one tiny distant figure, and text on open sky; and they spread over clearly different looks (open-view room, neon city, monumental scale, one-object meme, cozy cabin, hands from above). Our art was cluttered (drawings pinned on every wall), dark, showed a man up close with text across him, and A, B and C were three versions of one dark room with the same lettering. v2 makes every scene minimal and bright, keeps people out of the foreground, puts the text on open sky, gives each look its own lettering, and picks A, B and C from three different looks with three different phrases.

rules: 16:9 landscape YouTube thumbnail that still reads clearly at phone size: one clear subject, strong light-dark contrast, bright enough to read when small.
Minimal and uncluttered: no papers, posters, sketches or clutter on the walls or the desk; large calm empty areas.
No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks besides the phrase given.
Every object is plain and unbranded: no brand names, logos or trademarks anywhere.
No real or famous person and no recognisable face; at most hands, or one tiny distant figure; never a person in the foreground.
text_policy: Every phrase in texts is short, names focus or work (the channel is focus music for work, ADR-0044; mood words such as stillness or slow read as sleep or meditation), and makes no claim about brainwaves, Hz, ADHD, memory or health. The styles keep the brand's charcoal, graphite, warm amber and cool white (ADR-0044), except the neon city (saturated cyan and red neon, as the scan's cyberpunk winners #11, #12, #16) and the bright meme style.

cinematic_workspace_vista.label: Open view from a minimal room
cinematic_workspace_vista.prompt: Photorealistic wide cinematic photograph of a nearly empty, minimal modern room where a floor-to-ceiling window fills about 70 percent of the frame and opens onto {vista}. In the lower third, one simple desk with an open laptop and a small warm lamp, {accent}. Golden-hour or clear blue-hour light, a bright sky, strong warm-against-cool contrast, clean and calm, no people.
cinematic_workspace_vista.typography: Across the open sky in the upper middle, render the words "{text}" in thin, elegant, very widely letter-spaced capital letters in soft white with a faint glow, large enough to read on a phone.

electric_city_night.label: Neon city at night
electric_city_night.prompt: Cinematic digital art of a vast rain-wet futuristic city at night seen from high above: glowing towers, a deep black sky, saturated cyan and red-magenta neon reflecting on wet streets, volumetric fog, very high contrast. One small lone silhouette or motorbike in the lower foreground, no face visible.
electric_city_night.typography: Render the words "{text}" huge and bold in a heavy condensed sans-serif, stacked across the left half, bright white with a red-magenta neon glow, filling about half the frame width.

over_shoulder_worker.label: Hands at work, seen from above
over_shoulder_worker.prompt: Top-down photograph of a dark matte desk: two hands typing on a plain black keyboard, with only a closed notebook, a pen, wired earbuds and a cup of black coffee around them, neatly spaced. One soft light from above, rich deep blacks, minimal and orderly, no face.
over_shoulder_worker.typography: Across the upper middle, render the words "{text}" in bold, very widely letter-spaced capital letters in white.

monumental_minimal.label: Monumental scale, one tiny figure
monumental_minimal.prompt: Epic minimalist cinematic image of an enormous brutalist structure rising over {vista}, dwarfing a single tiny human figure far away. Dusk light with one warm light source, huge empty negative space, a sense of silence and scale, photorealistic.
monumental_minimal.typography: Render the word "{text}" in an elegant thin serif with wide letter spacing, centered in the empty sky, in warm off-white.

meme_object_lowercase.label: One object, lowercase caption
meme_object_lowercase.prompt: Clean product-style studio photograph of {object} centered on a plain {background} background, soft natural shadow, lots of empty space, no other objects, crisp and bright like an internet meme image.
meme_object_lowercase.typography: Below the object, render the text "{text}" in bold lowercase sans-serif letters ending with a period, in near-black, centered.
objects: a pair of plain unbranded over-ear headphones
a single steaming plain white ceramic coffee mug
a plain unbranded matte black mechanical keyboard
a simple brass desk lamp switched on
a closed plain black notebook with a pen on top

cozy_retreat_desk.label: Cozy cabin with a view
cozy_retreat_desk.prompt: Photorealistic cozy photograph of a warm wooden cabin room at dusk: a crackling fireplace, soft blankets on a chair, a glowing laptop on a low wooden desk, and a large window onto a snowy valley with small village lights. Warm amber light inside against cool blue outside, inviting and uncluttered, no people.
cozy_retreat_desk.typography: Across the window's sky, render the words "{text}" in soft white, widely letter-spaced capitals.
